pairs.note: Answer matches the key's core hurdle terms: 9% per annum IRR, compounded annually, and a hard hurdle. The omitted 50/50 GP catch-up to 20% of profits is carried-interest/waterfall mechanics that follow the hurdle rather than an element of the hurdle rate itself, so the substance of the term is the same.

Answer states only the current dollar figure ($7,500,000) and omits the governing formula: the greater of $7,500,000 or 2.0% of aggregate LP Capital Commitments. The greater-of test and the percentage basis are required elements — the commitment scales with fund size — so the bare amount understates the term.
